text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, to be expended
by authority of the Philippine Senate for the following purposes: Salaries and compensations of subordinate
personnel; salaries and wages of officers and employees of other branches of the Government who, at the
request of the President of the Philippine Senate and with the consent of their respective chiefs, render
services to the Senate in addition to their ordinary duties; traveling expenses of the President of the Senate and
transportation expenditures in Manila; rent of buildings; furniture; equipment, including uniforms of officers
and messengers of the Senate; stationery; printing and binding; postage; telegrams and cablegrams; electric
current; telephones, and other incidental expenses in connection with the organization and operation of the

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Approved, October 19, 1916.
